data.description: 【凯尔希 · 训练督导】战术模拟室坚硬的防爆玻璃前，凯尔希双臂环抱于胸前，目光冷静犀利地审视着场内干员的协同作战数据。她微微颔首——「干员们的战术配合有所提升。但在战场上，任何一丝侥幸心理都会导致无可挽回的伤亡，继续保持最高标准的警惕。」
data.promptProse: Kal'tsit stands arms crossed at the training arena's edge, observing several operators' drills with strict concentration. White lab coat with green trim, black dress, utility belt and emerald earrings retain her clinical outfit. The slight-low medium view places the uniformed trainees farther across the marked floor, clearly separate from her. Bright hall lights illuminate her coat and their equipment, with overhead spotlights casting contained shadows along the arena's receding practice lanes.
data.title: 凯尔希 · 训练督导
